title: WALK AND RUN CYCLE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 3, the animation pass, after the silhouettes. A body standing still is exactly as before. Walking, the feet now step the way the body is actually travelling, so backing away plays the stride backwards instead of moonwalking, the free hand works along the gun with each step and the shoulders rock with the legs. Sprinting, the stride is longer, the upper body tips into the run, the free arm pumps, and for a moment in each stride both feet leave the ground. Curved keeps her jiggle, still fed only by the body rising and falling. Nothing about play changes.
now: Bodies walk and run for real: feet step the way they travel, arms swing, a sprint leans in and leaves the ground.
